verdict.rationale: Salesforce markets Agentforce agents that can 'autonomously handle repetitive tasks' and 'Agent Script Recipes' for building agents, implying a natural-language/agentic layer over Sales Cloud, but the evidence never explicitly shows an end-user typing plain-English commands to operate the CRM (e.g., 'update this opportunity' via chat) — most detail is CLI/developer-facing (sf CLI, MCP server) rather than an end-user NL interface.  missing for 10: explicit end-user natural-language command examples, independent/hands-on verification that Agentforce responds to free-form commands, and confirmation this is available broadly (not just via developer tooling).
